terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH"; direnv exec . celery -A app.celery.celery_app worker

terminals.name: scheduler
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH"; direnv exec . celery -A app.celery.celery_app beat --scheduler redbeat.RedBeatScheduler
